name: [✨] Greedy Growers 🌱
desc:
Plant seeds and watch your trees grow to the moon! But be careful, lightning can strike at any moment! Don’t get too greedy…

🌊 Buy a seed from the river
🌱 Plant it in your plot
🌳 Watch your tree grow
⚡ Harvest before lightning strikes! 


🎮 Available on PC, Mobile, Tablet, and Console
